tonight.headline: The trade fixed this week's quarterback, not Week 7's — Washington are off too
body: Bad news first: you sent Saquon Barkley (ruled out, hamstring) and Carnell Tate to Kings of the North for Jayden Daniels and Isaiah Likely, and Daniels is your quarterback now — but Washington and Jacksonville are both on bye in Week 7, so Daniels and Lawrence are off together and you will need a quarterback for that one week. Rashee Rice is out again; Josh Jacobs cannot play until Week 7.

This week: 127.6 projected as set, which is the projection lineup, against 85.9; ESPN 72%. You trail 0 to 5.2 only because Emanuel Wilson played Thursday. Los Cachanillas still start Jalen Hurts (ruled out) and the Vikings' defence (on bye), with Kirk Cousins on their bench.

case.label: Why it can tighten
case.body: Cousins into their quarterback slot adds about 17 and any defence about 7: their ceiling is near 110, still under your 127.6.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Daniels on Washington's Saturday report. He was full Thursday and Friday with the left elbow (Commanders.com); if he is designated, Lawrence locks at 07:30 Sunday in London, so that call cannot wait for Monday.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: When the week rolls · decide on Week 7 projections, Tuesday
doFirst.title: Week 7: Daniels and Lawrence are both on bye — add a quarterback
doFirst.subtitle: Free agent, no priority. Winston is the candidate today; the drop is Lawrence.

case.label: The hole
case.body: Washington and Jacksonville both have their bye in Week 7 (ESPN schedule). After the trade your quarterbacks are Daniels (WSH) and Lawrence (JAX): zero available that week.

case.label: The candidate
case.body: Jameis Winston, a free agent: his fourth straight start with Dart on IR this week (Giants.com tracker 16 Oct), and the Giants' bye is Week 8. 16.8 projected for Week 6. Choose on Tuesday's Week 7 projections — whichever free quarterback projects highest.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Lawrence: a second quarterback who is benched behind Daniels and idle in Week 7. The cost is insurance on Daniels's left elbow — dislocated in Week 2, 11 games missed over two seasons (Fox Sports 28 Sep) — and the added quarterback inherits that insurance role. Lawrence is 89% rostered; the case against the market is that a 10-team, one-quarterback league always has a starter free.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The quarterback added scores less in Week 7 than another quarterback who was free at the moment of the add (archive), or Daniels is hurt before Week 8 and the added quarterback is not a starter.
